title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Human Biomechanics, Wearable Sensors, and Motion Capture
institution: The University of British Columbia (UBC Okanagan)
field: Human biomechanics, wearable sensors and motion capture
about: Postdoctoral fellowship at UBC Okanagan in Kelowna in human biomechanics, using wearable sensors and motion capture. The aggregator describes work including sports bra testing linked to lululemon scientists and an NSERC CREATE program.
card_alt: Postdoctoral Fellow - Human Biomechanics, Wearable Sensors, and Motion Capture at The University of British Columbia (UBC Okanagan), Kelowna, Canada; deadline 31 Oct 2026. The photo shows the Gooderham Building and downtown Toronto, in Toronto rather than Kelowna.
